name: hardstop
description: A spending firewall for your AI agent: it pays only through your vault, inside limits it cannot change.
long_description: HARDSTOP gives the assistant one wallet: a vault whose contract enforces your limits (per payment, per day, an end date, approved recipients, a pause switch). The assistant can check the vault, preview a payment, pay, list recipients and draft a request for more room. It cannot raise its own limit; no tool here can. Test networks only (Base Sepolia, Sepolia): the dollars have no value. Turn on Practice vault to try it with no keys.

tools.name: hardstop_status
tools.description: Limits, spending left today, balance and the worst case, read from the contract.

tools.name: hardstop_preview_payment
tools.description: Ask the vault whether a payment would go through, without sending it.

tools.name: hardstop_pay
tools.description: Pay from the vault; the contract refuses anything outside the limits.

tools.name: hardstop_recipients
tools.description: Which named recipients the vault will pay.

tools.name: hardstop_request_more
tools.description: Draft a request to the owner for more room. Changes nothing.

demo.title: Practice vault (no keys)
demo.description: Start a practice vault in memory: $10 a payment, $20 a day. Nothing is real. Turn off to use your own vault.

agent_key.title: Agent key
agent_key.description: The agent's private key from your vault's page on hardstop-omega.vercel.app. Never the owner's key. Stored in your system keychain.

vault.title: Vault address
vault.description: Your vault's address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).

chain_id.title: Network
chain_id.description: 84532 for Base Sepolia or 11155111 for Sepolia. Networks with real money are refused.

recipients.title: Recipient names
recipients.description: Optional names for approved recipients, such as Cloud hosting=0x...,GPU Market=0x...
